speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sharp lower back pain radiating to the leg and foot. I also have Pain worsens with movement, The onset of pain while exercising. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L4-L5 or L5-S1). The patient's description of sharp pain radiating down the leg and foot after exercise is classic for sciatica caused by a herniated disc, not iron deficiency anemia. I have requested an MRI to visualize the nerve compression and confirm the diagnosis.
